title: Build your character's complete arc
use_cases: Use when developing a comprehensive character development framework for creative writing
Implement when bridging a character's internal psychological trauma with their external plot goals
Configure when populating a story bible with consistent character growth trajectories
Use when generating structured narrative arcs based on specific emotional wounds and misbeliefs
content:
Five inputs — generates a full narrative arc summary you can drop straight into your story bible

Character name (optional)

The Wound Select wound type... Abandonment — left by someone depended on Betrayal — deceived by a trusted person Catastrophic failure — defining identity collapsed Irreplaceable loss — person or possibility gone Public humiliation — identity exposed and mocked Abuse — harmed by someone meant to protect them

The Misbelief Select misbelief... I am unlovable — people always leave I must control everything or I will be destroyed Trusting others always leads to pain I have no value unless I achieve something exceptional I am a burden to everyone who gets close to me The bad things that happened to me were my fault

The Want external goal Select want... Achieve professional or social recognition Win the love or approval of a specific person Make someone pay for what they did Create a situation where they can never be hurt again Gain enough power that no one can threaten them Find a place and people they truly belong with

The Need internal truth Select need... Accept themselves without conditions Let someone see them fully and stay anyway Forgive themselves or the person who hurt them Allow genuine connection rather than performing for approval Act from their values even when it costs everything Confront the truth they have been running from

Generate arc summary →
